items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Falls back to plan-side sections/*.md only when build config lists none; ask kept when neither side has sections; build config untouched.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Missing/nonexistent sections dir returns [] and falls to the existing ask; missing build config file already yields {}.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Split name is validated against resolved splits when they exist; read-only globbing, nothing written.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Four new tests: unseeded passes, no build config file, neither side asks, build-config sections win and missing file still asks.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One directory glob only on the previously failing path.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Small private helper next to its only caller; docstring and docs row updated.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Reads the build config and plan section files from disk; tests use real files on disk in the real layout, no format change.
